title: fix(scripts): js-comment-mask stops reading a JSX closing tag as a regex literal
body:
Fixes #6891

`scanSource` opens a REGEX when the byte before a `/` is not a value. A JSX closing tag (`LT SLASH div GT`) puts a `/` straight after a `LT`, so a phantom regex opened there and ran to end of line — flagging live JSX as literal content, the `)` that closes the enclosing call included.

**The rule is one token wide:** a `/` whose *immediately preceding byte* is `LT` opens nothing. It reads the raw byte rather than `prev`, because `prev` skips whitespace and `a LT /re/.test(b)` is a real regex that JSX cannot spell (`LT SPACE SLASH div GT` is not a closing tag).

## Judged-population delta, per affected gate

Measured before-vs-after on `cf7f2af6e` … `c2ba99c`, over all 4,322 tracked source files.

| gate | judged population before → after | how it was run |
|---|---|---|
| `check:vi-mock-specifiers` | 1,692 judged / 3 `embedded` → **unchanged**; output byte-identical | `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers`, exit 0, plus `--json` census diff |
| `check:vi-mock-inherit` | 130 covered / 0 `unreadable` → **unchanged**; output byte-identical | `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit`, exit 0, plus `--json` census diff |
| `check:doc-example-readers` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:doc-example-readers`, exit 0 |
| `check:docs-route-closure` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:docs-route-closure`, exit 0 |
| `check:element-data-source-declaration` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:element-data-source-declaration`, exit 0 |
| `check:entry-guard` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:entry-guard`, exit 0 |
| `check:pre-install-import-graph` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:pre-install-import-graph`, exit 0 |
| `check:sdui-registration-pins` (via `component-registrations.mjs`) | **405 `ComponentRegistry.register` calls across 512 files → identical, entry for entry** | source-side population diffed with the pre-fix and post-fix masker side by side; the gate itself needs a console build (declared below) |
| `check:side-effects-array` | output byte-identical | `pnpm check:side-effects-array`, exit 0 |

**The number that moves is the counterfactual one, and it is the point of the card.** Walking every `vi.mock` call site in the tree (1,695 sites) against the RAW mask — i.e. the population any future consumer sees without a private workaround:

```
unreadable (argument list does not balance)   7 sites in 7 files  →  0
embedded  (dropped from the judged population)      3            →  3
```

All 3 `embedded` sites are genuine code samples quoted in a string (`eslint-rules/no-dynamic-import-in-test-hook.test.js:37`, and two inside the help template in `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs`). None was a phantom-span victim, which matches the card: the silent direction was **latent, not live**. What closed is the path to it — the pin `a mock call after a JSX closing tag on the same line is JUDGED, not classified embedded` fails without this change.

Mask-level, both flag arrays diffed byte for byte:

```
files whose mask changed          1,623 of 4,322 — every one .tsx/.jsx;
                                  ZERO with any other extension
literal bytes released              129,998
literal bytes newly flagged             145   (a DIFFERENT defect — below)
comment bytes changed, either way         0
```

## What this does NOT fix

The 145 residual bytes are a second defect, deliberately untouched: a `/` after `}` or `GT`. That is the **self-closing** tag (`Foo bar={x} SLASH GT`) and a `/` in JSX **text** (`{a}/{b}`). They were invisible before only because the closing tag's larger phantom started earlier on the same line and covered them.

There is no one-token rule for that half — the card said so and the measurement agrees. `/` followed by `GT` is exactly how a regex matching a `GT` is spelled (`str.replace(/GT/g, '>')`), and both `}` and `GT` before a `/` are genuinely ambiguous in JavaScript (`function f(){} /re/` is a regex; `a GT /re/.test(b)` parses). Separating them needs to know whether the scanner is inside an element — a parser, which this module deliberately is not. Filed separately; pinned here as KNOWN LIMITS so it cannot be closed silently.

## Anti-vacuous leg

The module's `--self-test` is wired into **no** workflow and no `package.json` script (`git grep` finds the string only in its own header), so a self-test case alone would not run on any PR. The new `scripts/__tests__/js-comment-mask-jsx-6891.test.ts` pins the flags directly **and** executes that self-test as a subprocess, which is what puts it on every PR.

Ablation, from the committed state, with a restore trap and on-disk proof (marker count 1 → 0, blob hash `bd0256f7` → `0a910547`):

```
self-test under mutation   7 of 45 cases FAIL   (0 with the fix)
vitest pins under mutation 12 tests FAIL, 64 pass (0 fail with the fix)
restore                    hash matches HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty
```

The 64 that stayed green under mutation are the negative controls and the KNOWN-LIMIT pins — they are what stop the assertions above from passing on any scanner that simply flags less.

## The #6849 workaround: now removable, deliberately NOT removed here

`deJsxClosingTags` in `check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` is redundant as of this change — measured: with the fix, the raw mask already balances all 7 sites, and the gate's output is byte-identical with the rewrite still applied. It is **left in place**: that gate's source is outside this card's file surface, and #6998 is serialised behind this PR in the same area. Its removal is a follow-up.

Its two-way pin, however, was authored to fail the day the shared masker was fixed ("If the shared masker is ever fixed this case fails and the workaround can be retired deliberately"). It did exactly that, so it is turned over in place to assert the fix. That one test file is the sole deviation from the declared file surface, and it is a mechanical consequence rather than a choice — see the report comment on #6891.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over the 10 script pin tests that import this module: **266 passed**
- 5 package tests reading `component-registrations.mjs` (`layout`, `components`, `fields`): **43 passed**
- `pnpm type-check:scripts` exit 0 · `pnpm lint:root` exit 0 over its **full** 248-file population (no narrowing; all three changed files present in it)
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:upstream-port-parity`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:node-esm-load`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `type-check:coverage`, `lint:coverage`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:shell-escape-residue`: all exit 0
- `turbo ls --affected` from the merge base: **0 packages** — this diff touches no workspace package
- **Changeset:** `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0 — *"3 file(s) changed, 0 of them published source of a package the release covers … no changeset is owed."* Root `scripts/` ships from no package. No `skip-changeset` label (dead on this repo, #4912).
- **Declared narrowing:** `check:sdui-registration-pins` and `check:eager-closure` both report `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` locally (no `apps/console/dist`) — identically before and after this change. Rather than hold the shared verify lock for a console build that cannot move them, the gate's *input* population was measured directly and is identical (405 calls / 512 files). CI's `Bundle Analysis` job runs them for real; this path is in its `paths:` filter.
